instructions: US state sales-tax figures (plan WP C2, SaaS-grade): per-state taxability,
rates and economic-nexus thresholds for an email-sending SaaS.
This file ships EMPTY on purpose: the platform does not invent rates.
Every row must be filled by the owner (or the accounting service) from the
state's own published rate schedule / nexus statute, with the exact source
URL and the date the figure was read. A row is a factual claim about a
state's tax law and is only as good as its source and retrieval date.
Row fields:
state               ISO 3166-2:US two-letter code (e.g. "CA").
taxability          "taxable" | "not_taxable" (the product — email
sending — taxed in that state, or not). ABSENT or an
unrecognised value resolves to not_taxable: never
over-collect where the product is exempt. A
"taxable" row REQUIRES a rate. A not_taxable row
carrying rates/thresholds is allowed but those
figures are NOT used (never charged, never asked to
register) — `--check` reports them as dead data.
rateBps             state sales-tax rate in BASIS POINTS (7.25% = 725).
State-level rate only; county/city/district add-ons
are NOT included unless the row also carries the
combined rate below.
combinedRateBps     OPTIONAL home-rule combined rate in basis points
(state + local, e.g. 8.80% = 880). When present it
is the rate invoices compute with, and it requires
its OWN combinedSourceUrl + combinedRetrieved (the
figures' own provenance and staleness clock).
combinedSourceUrl   https:// URL the combined rate was read from.
combinedRetrieved   YYYY-MM-DD the combined rate was read.
nexusThresholdCents economic-nexus GROSS-SALES threshold in USD CENTS
($100,000 = 10000000). Required when criteria
declares "sales" or "either"; forbidden for
"transactions".
transactionThreshold economic-nexus TRANSACTION-COUNT threshold (e.g.
200). Required when criteria declares
"transactions" or "either"; forbidden for
"sales".
criteria            "sales" (default when absent) | "transactions" |
"either" — which statutory test(s) the sweep
evaluates. A row declaring a criterion whose
threshold is missing is a DATA ERROR: the state is
refused at evaluation time and reported, never
evaluated against a guessed threshold.
nexusWindow         "calendar" (the evaluation window is the calendar
year) or "trailing_12m" (the trailing twelve
months). Required whenever thresholds are declared.
Match the state's statute.
sourceUrl           https:// URL of the state's page for the figures.
retrieved           YYYY-MM-DD the figures were read from that page.
notes               optional, free text (e.g. what is not modelled).
How the figures are used:
* An invoice charges tax only when the owner has REGISTERED the state
(admin surface, a legal act), the row is present and taxable, and the
USED rate stamp (combined when present, else the state rate) is not
older than US_TAX_MAX_AGE_DAYS (default 120). Otherwise the invoice is
refused, never computed from a guessed or stale rate.
* A customer holding a valid exemption certificate for the state is
charged zero tax (the certificate is recorded on the invoice snapshot);
the sale still counts as gross sales toward the nexus tests and is
reported separately as exempt sales.
* The sweep tracks USD gross sales AND transaction counts (both, always)
and alerts once per window on the FIRST crossing of whichever declared
criterion is reached, plus ONE early warning at US_TAX_WARN_FRACTION
(default 0.8) of the threshold. not_taxable states are never tracked,
never asked to register, never charged.

Validate after editing: `billing-service --check-us-tax-data-only` (or BILLING_CHECK_US_TAX_DATA_ONLY=true); it prints every row with its age and exits non-zero on any validation or per-state data error.
